items.text: Romanian Macao: 2s and 3s remain draw cards; Jokers wild (black draw 5, red draw 10); 4s block 2s/3s; 7s block; Aces skip a turn; 7s change suit. Regional rules vary (more or less restricted stacking).

Tel-Aviv / London Variation: 2–3 players get 7 cards, 4+ get 5; Aces and Queens wild (no Jokers); 2 and 3 stack; King of Hearts next draws 5; 5 allows playing another card same turn; point play to 500 (points are bad).
52-Card Deck: Use full 52-card deck instead of 32; same rules, more players or longer games.
